description: This file defines a static class 'AssetChildFlows' containing multiple asynchronous methods that manage various child resource operations associated with assets in a data asset management system. The methods include creating, listing, retrieving by ID, updating, and linking related entities such as asset status logs, additional asset IDs, properties, control device mappings, input parameters, input/output mappings, reporting attributes, EF source mappings, throughput equations and scalars, data input values, and parent input mappings. The class serves as a service layer for asset-related workflows, ensuring validation and proper interaction with the repository layer.

classes.name: AssetChildFlows
classes.description: A static class providing methods to perform CRUD and linking operations on asset-related child resources, facilitating workflow orchestration and validation within the data asset management system.

methods.name: CreateAssetStatusLogAsync
methods.description: Creates a new asset status log entry for a specified asset, validating asset existence and status date chronology.

methods.name: ListAssetStatusLogsAsync
methods.description: Retrieves a list of status logs for a specified asset.

methods.name: GetAssetStatusLogByIdAsync
methods.description: Fetches a specific status log by its ID under an asset.

methods.name: UpdateAssetStatusLogAsync
methods.description: Updates a specific status log, ensuring chronology rules are followed.

methods.name: CreateAdditionalAssetIdAsync
methods.description: Creates an additional asset ID entry linked to an asset.

methods.name: ListAdditionalAssetIdsAsync
methods.description: Lists all additional asset IDs for a given asset.

methods.name: GetAdditionalAssetIdByIdAsync
methods.description: Retrieves an additional asset ID by its ID, scoped to an asset.

methods.name: UpdateAdditionalAssetIdAsync
methods.description: Updates details of an additional asset ID.

methods.name: CreateAssetPropertyAsync
methods.description: Creates a new property entry under an asset.

methods.name: ListAssetPropertiesAsync
methods.description: Lists all properties associated with an asset.

methods.name: GetAssetPropertyByIdAsync
methods.description: Retrieves an asset property by its ID.

methods.name: UpdateAssetPropertyAsync
methods.description: Updates an asset property specified by its ID.

methods.name: CreateControlDeviceMappingAsync
methods.description: Creates a control device mapping related to an asset.

methods.name: ListControlDeviceMappingsAsync
methods.description: Lists all control device mappings for an asset.

methods.name: GetControlDeviceMappingByIdAsync
methods.description: Retrieves a specific control device mapping by ID.

methods.name: UpdateControlDeviceMappingAsync
methods.description: Updates a control device mapping by ID.

methods.name: CreateInputParameterAsync
methods.description: Creates an input parameter under an asset.

methods.name: ListInputParametersAsync
methods.description: Lists all input parameters for an asset.

methods.name: GetInputParameterByIdAsync
methods.description: Retrieves an input parameter by ID under an asset.

methods.name: UpdateInputParameterAsync
methods.description: Updates an input parameter by ID.

methods.name: CreateParentInputMappingAsync
methods.description: Creates a mapping from a child input parameter to a parent input parameter within an asset.

methods.name: ListParentInputMappingsAsync
methods.description: Lists parent input mappings for a given child input parameter.

methods.name: UpdateParentInputMappingAsync
methods.description: Updates a parent input mapping by its ID.

methods.name: CreateReportingAttributeMappingAsync
methods.description: Creates a mapping of reporting attributes within an asset.

methods.name: ListReportingAttributeMappingsAsync
methods.description: Lists all reporting attribute mappings for an asset.

methods.name: GetReportingAttributeMappingByIdAsync
methods.description: Retrieves a reporting attribute mapping by ID.

methods.name: UpdateReportingAttributeMappingAsync
methods.description: Updates a reporting attribute mapping by ID.

methods.name: ListEfSourceMappingsAsync
methods.description: Lists EF source mappings for an input parameter.

methods.name: UpdateEfSourceMappingAsync

methods.description: Creates a throughput equation for an input parameter.

methods.name: ListThroughputEquationsAsync
methods.description: Lists throughput equations for an input parameter.

methods.name: UpdateThroughputEquationAsync
methods.description: Updates a throughput equation by ID.

methods.name: CreateThroughputScalarAsync
methods.description: Creates a throughput scalar under an input parameter and throughput equation.

methods.name: ListThroughputScalarsAsync
methods.description: Lists throughput scalars for a specific throughput equation.

methods.name: UpdateThroughputScalarAsync
methods.description: Updates a throughput scalar by ID.

methods.name: ListDataInputValuesAsync

methods.name: UpdateDataInputValueAsync
methods.description: Updates a data input value by ID.
